newsitem.title: USA: Williams to redeem QUICS, $2.21 preferred.
newsitem.headline: Williams to redeem QUICS, $2.21 preferred.

text.p: Williams Cos Inc said Monday directors called for redemption all the issued and outstanding 9.60 pct QUICS -- Quarterly Income Capital Securities -- and $2.21 cumulative preferred stock.

The $2.21 preferred will be redeemed September 1 at a price of $25 per share plus all unpaid dividends, the company said. The board approved a dividend of $0.55.25 per share on this preferred payable September 1, the normal dividend date, to holdes of record August 15.
It said the QUICS will be redeemed on September 30, the normal interest payment date.
Williams said it will pay the $69 million principal, plus the interest due on that date, to holders of record on September 15. Absent recdemption, these securities would be due in 2025.
